chunks: Abu Ali Ahmad ibn Abi Ja'far al-Bayhaqi narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ja'far al-Madini narrated to us, saying: Abu Ja'far al-Muharibi narrated to us, saying: Dhaheer ibn Salih al-Amri narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Tamim narrated to us, saying: Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman informed us, from his father, from Yazid al-Raqqashi, from Anas ibn Malik, saying:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) led us in the dawn prayer. When he finished from his prayer, he turned towards us with his generous face and said: O people, whoever misses the sun, let him hold fast to the moon; and whoever misses the moon, let him hold fast to Zuhra (Venus); and whoever misses Zuhra, let him hold fast to the Two Farqads (stars). It was said: O Messenger of Allah, what are the sun, the moon, Zuhra, and the two Farqads? He said: I am the Sun, Ali is the Moon, Fatima is Zuhra, and Hasan and Husayn are the two Farqads. And the Book of Allah will not be separated from them until they come to me at the Basin.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House, referring to the Prophet's family
key_terms.الزُّهْرَةُ: Venus (the morning star), used as a metaphor for Fatima
key_terms.الْحَوْضَ: The Basin, a reservoir in Paradise from which the Prophet will serve believers on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.الْفَرْقَدَانِ: The Two Farqads, referring to the stars Aldebaran and another, used here to denote Hasan and Husayn

ai.seo_question: What celestial metaphors did the Prophet use for the Ahl al-Bayt in this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Ma'ani al-Akhbar employs celestial metaphors to establish the spiritual hierarchy and inseparable unity of the Ahl al-Bayt, a concept central to Shia cosmology. By linking the Prophet, Ali, Fatima, and the Two Imams with the Quran until their reunion at al-Hawd, the text underscores their role as the enduring guides of the community. The 'Two Farqads' (Polaris) specifically highlight the unique status of Hasan and Husayn as the guiding stars of the faithful.

en.basel-kadem: 4.	We were told by Abu Ali, Ahmad bin Abi Ja’far al-Bayhaqi, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ja’far al-Madini, that he said: We were told by Abu Ja’far al-Muharibi, that he said: We were told by Dhaheer bin Saleh al-‘Amri, that he said: We were told by Yahya bin Tamim, that he said: We were informed by Mu’tamir bin Sulayman, from his father, from Yazid al-Raqqashi, from Anas bin Malik, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, lead us in the dawn prayer, and when he departed from it, he approached us with his generous face and said: All people, the one who misses the sun, let him adhere to the moon, and the one who misses the moon, let him adhere to Zuhra, and the one who misses Zuhra, let him adhere to the Two Farqads. It was said: O Allah’s Messenger, what is the sun, the moon, the Zuhra and the two Farqads? He said: I am the Sun, Ali is the Moon, Fatima is the Zuhra and Hasan and Hussain are the two Farqads. So is the Book of Allah; they will not be separated until they come to me at the basin.
